title: QLOG-P8-BANK: counted linear classical control for the fourth-scale profile

claims.statement: For every integer N>=2 and every secret s in Z/NZ, the ONE QLOG-P8-BANK physical interpreter in proof.md Sections 0-5 executing the selected V in virtual.md Section 1, with n=ceil(log2 N), recovers all of s with unconditional probability at least 1-2^-8. On every branch, jointly with all other declared bounds and the zero malformed-fraction guarantee, it has worst-case total charged work T=O(2^((3/4)sqrt(n log2 n)+(3/4)sqrt(n)(log2 n)^(-3/8)-(3/32)sqrt(n)(log2 n)^(-7/16)+(1/16)sqrt(n)(log2 n)^(-15/32))), with absolute outer constants independent of N,s,outcomes. Logarithmic envelopes are asymptotic for n>=2; the explicit finite branch handles n=1. The exact representative growth index is 1/2.

For every integer N>=2 and every secret s in Z/NZ, the ONE QLOG-P8-BANK physical interpreter in proof.md Sections 0-5 executing the selected V in virtual.md Section 1, with n=ceil(log2 N), recovers all of s with unconditional probability at least 1-2^-8. On every branch, jointly with all other declared bounds and the zero malformed-fraction guarantee, it has peak physical classical bits S_C=O(n), with absolute outer constants independent of N,s,outcomes. Logarithmic envelopes are asymptotic for n>=2; the explicit finite branch handles n=1. The exact representative growth index is 0.

For every integer N>=2 and every secret s in Z/NZ, the ONE QLOG-P8-BANK physical interpreter in proof.md Sections 0-5 executing the selected V in virtual.md Section 1, with n=ceil(log2 N), recovers all of s with unconditional probability at least 1-2^-8. On every branch, jointly with all other declared bounds and the zero malformed-fraction guarantee, it has peak physical accessible qubits S_Q=O(n^2), including the entire padded basis bank, unused cells, metadata, mapped coherent slots and source temporary wires, with absolute outer constants independent of N,s,outcomes. Logarithmic envelopes are asymptotic for n>=2; the explicit finite branch handles n=1. The exact representative growth index is 0.

For every integer N>=2 and every secret s in Z/NZ, the ONE QLOG-P8-BANK physical interpreter in proof.md Sections 0-5 executing the selected V in virtual.md Section 1, with n=ceil(log2 N), recovers all of s with unconditional probability at least 1-2^-8. On every branch, jointly with all other declared bounds and the zero malformed-fraction guarantee, it has total acquired original source copies Q=O(2^((1/2)sqrt(n log2 n)-(3/2)sqrt(n)(log2 n)^(-3/8)+(3/16)sqrt(n)(log2 n)^(-7/16)-(3/32)sqrt(n)(log2 n)^(-15/32))), with absolute outer constants independent of N,s,outcomes. Logarithmic envelopes are asymptotic for n>=2; the explicit finite branch handles n=1. The exact representative growth index is 1/2.

For the same ONE QLOG-P8-BANK physical interpreter and configuration in proof.md Sections 0-5 executing the selected V in virtual.md Section 1, the proved malformed-sample fraction is epsilon(n)=0: all acquired copies are independent ideal coset states. For every N>=2 and every secret s, unconditional full-secret success is at least 1-2^-8 jointly with all four branchwise resource bounds. No positive tolerance or impossibility of positive tolerance is asserted.

structured.error_model: Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
